test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 1 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Where is Raisina Hill?

options.text: It is the place where the Dogra rulers of Jammu and Kashmir built their fort in Jammu
It is situated in the same location as Rashtrapati Bhavan.
It is the rock feature at Kanyakumari where Swami Vivekananda's statue was erected.

solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**It is situated in the same location as Rashtrapati Bhavan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raisina Hill**, is an area of New Delhi, housing India's most important government buildings, including Rashtrapati Bhavan, the official residence of the President of India and the Prime Minister's Office and several other important ministries.
 
• The word Raisina Hill is often used as a metonym for the seat of the **Government of India.**
 
• Surrounded by important buildings and structures, including the **Parliament** of India, **Rajpath**, and **India Gate**.
 
• The term was coined following the acquisition of land from 300 families from local villages was acquired under "1894 Land Acquisition Act" to begin the construction of the Viceroy's House.
 
• The "hill" is a slightly elevated **266 m (873 ft) high**, about **18 m (59 ft)** higher than the surrounding area.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Bahu Fort** is a fortress that represents the lavishness of the Dogra kings and the royal family that resided to rule the region.
 
• **Hari Parbat** also known as Kooh-e-Maran lies on the west of Dal Lake in Srinagar, in the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir.
 
• **Vivekananda Rock Memorial** is a monument and popular tourist attraction in Kanyakumari.
